title: Test 5 – Miêu tả Người (Thử thách từ vựng mới & Xáo trộn)

exercises.instruction: Mô tả hành động đẩy.

options.text: They are moving a cart by pushing it.
They are pulling a rope.
They are parking the vehicle.
They are washing a car.

exercises.explanation: Moving a cart by pushing it (di chuyển xe đẩy bằng cách đẩy).

exercises.instruction: Điền danh từ chỉ các phím.
exercises.content: Her hands are positioned over the ________ of a laptop.
exercises.explanation: Keys (các phím trên bàn phím).

exercises.instruction: Chọn mô tả đúng nhất.

options.text: The instructor is erasing the board.
A woman is adding text to a whiteboard.
The whiteboard is completely blank.
She is carrying a whiteboard.

exercises.explanation: 'Adding text to a whiteboard' là một cách nói khác của 'writing on a board'.

exercises.instruction: Chọn câu miêu tả vị trí.

options.text: The man is sitting under the desk.
The man is on his feet beside the desk.
He is lying down near the table.
He is crawling on the floor.

exercises.explanation: 'On his feet' là cụm từ diễn đạt tư thế đứng.

exercises.instruction: Điền động từ chỉ hành động nắm chặt tay.
exercises.content: Two men are ________ hands as a greeting.
exercises.explanation: Clasping hands (nắm chặt tay) có thể dùng thay cho shaking hands.

exercises.instruction: Điền tính từ miêu tả tay áo.
exercises.content: The man is wearing a long-________ shirt with a pattern.
exercises.explanation: Long-sleeved shirt (áo sơ mi dài tay).

exercises.instruction: Mô tả nội dung trên màn hình.

options.text: The computer shows a warning message.
A movie is playing on the screen.
The screen is turned off.
A document is being typed.

exercises.explanation: Warning message (thông báo cảnh báo/lỗi).

exercises.instruction: Điền danh từ chỉ thiết bị.
exercises.content: He is speaking into a mobile ________.
exercises.explanation: Thiết bị di động: mobile device / mobile phone.

exercises.instruction: Mô tả loại áo khoác.

options.text: He is clothed in a reflective vest.
He is wearing a heavy winter jacket.
He is putting on a raincoat.
He is removing his vest.

exercises.explanation: Reflective vest (áo phản quang).

exercises.instruction: Điền danh từ chỉ cầu thang.
exercises.content: People are using the ________ to go down.
exercises.explanation: Stairs / staircase (cầu thang).

exercises.instruction: Hành động với tài liệu.

options.text: The woman is reading from a printed book.
She is writing a novel.
She is drawing a picture in a book.
She is scanning a document into a computer.

exercises.explanation: Reading from a printed book (đọc từ sách in).

exercises.instruction: Hành động nào đúng với ảnh?

options.text: A knapsack is being carried on the student's back.
A backpack is being unzipped.
He is filling his backpack with books.
He is throwing away a bag.

exercises.explanation: 'Knapsack' là từ đồng nghĩa của backpack.

exercises.instruction: Điền bộ phận cơ thể.
exercises.content: He is using his ________ to draw attention to the screen.
exercises.explanation: Dùng ngón tay (finger) hoặc bàn tay (hand) để chỉ.

exercises.instruction: Mô tả trạng thái của những chiếc ghế.

options.text: The chairs are stacked in a corner.
The chairs are occupied by several people.
The chairs are completely empty.
The chairs are being polished.

exercises.explanation: The chairs are occupied (những chiếc ghế đang được ngồi/chiếm chỗ).

exercises.instruction: Điền động từ chỉ việc làm sạch.
exercises.content: A person is using a broom to ________ up.
exercises.explanation: Clean up (dọn dẹp sạch sẽ).

exercises.instruction: Điền cụm từ miêu tả trang phục.
exercises.content: He is wearing formal business ________.
exercises.explanation: Business attire/clothing là trang phục công sở.

exercises.instruction: Điền danh từ chỉ kính mắt.
exercises.content: The man is wearing framed ________.
exercises.explanation: Framed spectacles (kính có gọng).

exercises.instruction: Điền danh từ chỉ màn hình.
exercises.content: The worker is viewing information on a computer ________.
exercises.explanation: Màn hình máy tính: screen / monitor / display.

exercises.instruction: Trạng thái của chiếc cà vạt.

options.text: The tie is loosely draped over a chair.
He has a tie neatly knotted at his neck.
He is taking his tie off.
He is buying a striped tie.

exercises.explanation: Neatly knotted at his neck (được thắt gọn gàng ở cổ).

exercises.instruction: Điền danh từ chỉ một gánh nặng/tải trọng.
exercises.content: The individual is bearing a ________ on his head.
exercises.explanation: Bearing a load (chịu một gánh nặng/chở đồ).

exercises.instruction: Mô tả hành động của cô gái.

options.text: She is spilling her drink on the table.
She is hydrating herself with a drink.
She is making coffee.
She is washing a dirty cup.

exercises.explanation: Hydrating herself (đang cấp nước cho bản thân/đang uống).

exercises.instruction: Mô tả trạng thái của người đàn ông.

options.text: The man is poised to write with a pen.
He is putting the pen in his pocket.
He is biting the cap of his pen.
The pen is rolling off the table.

exercises.explanation: 'Poised to write' (trong tư thế sẵn sàng viết).

exercises.instruction: Mô tả nào khớp với hình ảnh?

options.text: The construction worker has a hard hat on his head.
He is holding a yellow helmet in his hands.
He is painting his helmet.
The helmet is lying on the ground.

exercises.explanation: 'Has a hard hat on his head' tương đương với wearing a safety helmet.

exercises.instruction: Điền danh từ chỉ phần nửa dưới của trang phục.
exercises.content: The lower half of her outfit is a long ________.
exercises.explanation: Long skirt (váy dài).

exercises.instruction: Hành động soi gương.

options.text: He is hanging a mirror on the wall.
He is checking his appearance in a mirror.
He is buying a new mirror.
He is packing a mirror.

exercises.explanation: Checking his appearance (kiểm tra diện mạo/vẻ ngoài).

exercises.instruction: Câu dùng bị động.

options.text: A package is being picked up from the ground.
A package is being delivered.
The man is tearing the package apart.
A box is falling from a truck.

exercises.explanation: Being picked up (đang được nhấc lên).

exercises.instruction: Điền tính từ miêu tả vị trí.
exercises.content: The woman is ________ beside the glass window.
exercises.explanation: Positioned beside (Được bố trí/đặt ở vị trí bên cạnh).

exercises.instruction: Cách diễn đạt câu phức về trang phục.

options.text: The woman clad in red is conversing.
A red dress is walking.
The woman wears a red dress and cry.
She is buying a red dress.

exercises.explanation: 'Clad in red' là cách dùng từ vựng rất cao để miêu tả trang phục màu đỏ.

exercises.instruction: Điền tính từ/phân từ chỉ sự chồng chéo.
exercises.content: Her legs are ________ while sitting.
exercises.explanation: Overlapped (chồng lên nhau).

exercises.instruction: Điền tính từ/phó từ chỉ hướng xuống.
exercises.content: She is leaning ________ towards the floor.
exercises.explanation: Leaning down (cúi xuống).

exercises.instruction: Mô tả chi tiết nhóm người.

options.text: They are all very angry.
A single lady among them is showing a smile.
They are all looking away.
One of the men is wearing a hat.

exercises.explanation: A single lady among them (Một quý cô duy nhất trong số họ).

exercises.instruction: Điền danh từ chỉ cái nắm/bắt.
exercises.content: The document is held firmly in his right ________.
exercises.explanation: Grasp / grip (cái nắm tay).

exercises.instruction: Sử dụng cụm phân từ hoàn thành câu.
exercises.content: ________ in a suit, the man is grasping a bag.
exercises.explanation: 'Dressed in a suit' là cụm quá khứ phân từ rút gọn hợp lý.

exercises.instruction: Chuẩn bị qua đường.

options.text: They are preparing to cross the roadway.
They are running a marathon.
They are sitting in a parked car.
They are painting the lines on the road.

exercises.explanation: Preparing to cross the roadway (chuẩn bị băng qua đường).

exercises.instruction: Điền danh từ chỉ quá trình.
exercises.content: He is in the ________ of wearing his jacket.
exercises.explanation: In the process of (đang trong quá trình làm gì).

exercises.instruction: Mô tả người làm việc.

options.text: The freelancer is typing on his laptop.
The man is repairing his laptop.
The laptop is closed.
He is watching a movie at the cinema.

exercises.explanation: Freelancer is typing (người làm tự do đang gõ máy).

exercises.instruction: Mô tả hành động đa nhiệm.

options.text: He is multitasking with a drink and a phone.
He is pouring a drink on his phone.
He is talking on the phone only.
He is washing a cup.

exercises.explanation: Multitasking (làm nhiều việc cùng lúc).

exercises.instruction: Mô tả áo được cài nút.

options.text: The shirt is completely fastened.
The shirt is torn at the seam.
The shirt is hanging to dry.
He is sewing a button.

exercises.explanation: Completely fastened (được cài chặt hoàn toàn) = buttoned up.

exercises.instruction: Cấu trúc với supported by.

options.text: His body is supported by the wall behind him.
He is carrying the wall.
He is jumping over a fence.
The wall is falling down.

exercises.explanation: Supported by the wall (Được chống đỡ bởi bức tường) = leaning.

exercises.instruction: Điền từ phủ định chỉ 2 người.
exercises.content: ________ man is without a tie.
exercises.explanation: 'Neither man is without a tie' (Không người đàn ông nào không có cà vạt) = Both have ties.

exercises.instruction: Tình trạng cái túi xách.

options.text: A handbag is slung over her arm.
The bag has fallen on the ground.
She is unzipping her purse.
She is hiding her bag.

exercises.explanation: Slung over her arm (treo lủng lẳng/khoác lên cánh tay).

exercises.instruction: Điền tính từ miêu tả sự tự tin.
exercises.content: A man in professional attire stands ________.
exercises.explanation: Stands confidently (đứng một cách tự tin).

exercises.instruction: Điền tính từ/phân từ 'được đeo/mặc'.
exercises.content: A timepiece is ________ on his left arm.
exercises.explanation: Worn (được đeo).

exercises.instruction: So sánh các tư thế.

options.text: All of the people are standing up.
While some are seated, one individual is standing.
Everyone is sleeping.
While some are jumping, one is walking.

exercises.explanation: Sử dụng 'while' để thể hiện sự tương phản giữa seated và standing.

exercises.instruction: Điền tính từ chỉ sự trang trọng.
exercises.content: They are outfitted in ________ wear.
exercises.explanation: Formal wear (trang phục trang trọng).

exercises.instruction: Điền động từ chỉ việc nhìn lén/nhìn chăm chú.
exercises.content: He is ________ outside through the glass.
exercises.explanation: Peering (nhìn ngó, nhìn hé qua).

exercises.instruction: Hoạt động nói chuyện.

options.text: They are listening to music together.
They are engaged in a verbal exchange.
They are signing a contract.
They are watching a performance.

exercises.explanation: Verbal exchange (Sự trao đổi bằng lời nói).

exercises.instruction: Cách diễn đạt khác cho khoanh tay.

options.text: His arms are crossed firmly in front of him.
He is stretching his arms behind his back.
He is raising his arms in victory.
His arms are resting on a desk.

exercises.explanation: Crossed firmly (Được vắt chéo/khoanh lại chắc chắn).

exercises.instruction: Điền danh từ chỉ con mắt/ánh nhìn.
exercises.content: Her ________ are directed away from the monitor.
exercises.explanation: Her eyes are directed away (Ánh mắt của cô ấy hướng ra xa).

exercises.instruction: Điền danh từ chỉ hình dáng (vòng tròn).
exercises.content: The group has formed a ________ around the table.
exercises.explanation: Formed a circle (Tạo thành một vòng tròn ngồi quanh bàn).

exercises.instruction: Điền danh từ chỉ bài phát biểu chính.
exercises.content: The presenter is delivering a ________ to the crowd.
exercises.explanation: Delivering a keynote (trình bày một bài phát biểu quan trọng).

exercises.instruction: Mô tả trang phục lộng lẫy/trang trọng.

options.text: The man is garbed in exquisite formal wear.
The man is wearing worn-out jeans.
The man is dressed for swimming.
The man has taken off his coat.

exercises.explanation: Garbed in exquisite formal wear (Khoác lên mình bộ trang phục trang trọng tinh tế).

exercises.instruction: Điền cụm từ đối diện.
exercises.content: They are positioned face-to-________.
exercises.explanation: Face-to-face (đối mặt nhau).

exercises.instruction: Điền tính từ chỉ chiều dọc.
exercises.content: Cartons are being arranged in a ________ pile.
exercises.explanation: Vertical pile (chồng theo chiều dọc).

exercises.instruction: Giao nhận tài liệu.

options.text: Paperwork is being passed from one to another.
The paperwork is being shredded.
They are tearing up the documents.
The papers have blown away.

exercises.explanation: Being passed from one to another (Được chuyền từ người này sang người kia).

exercises.instruction: Điền động từ tiến lên/di chuyển.
exercises.content: They are ________ side by side.
exercises.explanation: Progressing side by side (Đang tiến bước sóng vai nhau).

exercises.instruction: Điền động từ chỉ sự tinh chỉnh.
exercises.content: He is ________ the position of his eyewear.
exercises.explanation: Tweaking / adjusting (Tùy chỉnh/điều chỉnh).

exercises.instruction: Điền danh từ chỉ tài liệu thiết kế/bản vẽ.
exercises.content: The architectural ________ are being reviewed.
exercises.explanation: Architectural plans / blueprints (Bản vẽ kiến trúc).

exercises.instruction: Điền danh từ chỉ cuộc đi bộ thư giãn.
exercises.content: A leisurely ________ is being taken in the park.
exercises.explanation: Leisurely walk (cuộc tản bộ thong thả).

exercises.instruction: Mô tả góc nhìn của người xem.

options.text: The person's back is turned to the viewer.
The person is staring at the viewer.
The person is walking toward the camera.
The person's face is clearly visible.

exercises.explanation: Back is turned to the viewer (Quay lưng về phía người xem).

exercises.instruction: Dọn dẹp bề mặt.

options.text: The surface is being wiped clean with a cloth.
The table is being scratched.
A cloth is being washed in the sink.
The surface is completely covered in dust.

exercises.explanation: Wiped clean with a cloth (được lau sạch bằng vải).

exercises.instruction: Điền trạng từ/động từ chỉ sự xếp hàng chờ.
exercises.content: Individuals are lined up ________ for their turn.
exercises.explanation: Lined up waiting (xếp hàng chờ đợi).

exercises.instruction: Điền động từ chỉ việc thu người/quỳ.
exercises.content: The person is ________ on one knee.
exercises.explanation: Crouching on one knee (Thu mình/Quỳ trên một đầu gối).

exercises.instruction: Điền tính từ chỉ sự không trang trọng.
exercises.content: She is wearing ________, relaxed clothing.
exercises.explanation: Informal, relaxed clothing (Quần áo thư giãn, không trang trọng).

exercises.instruction: Tư thế tiến sát quầy.

options.text: The customer is leaning forward over the counter.
The customer is sleeping on the counter.
The customer is walking away from the desk.
The customer is cleaning the counter.

exercises.explanation: Leaning forward over the counter (nhoài người về phía trước qua quầy).

exercises.instruction: Cuộc đối thoại chuyên sâu.

options.text: They are deeply engrossed in a conversation.
They are quickly leaving the room.
They are distracted by their phones.
They are whispering secrets.

exercises.explanation: Engrossed in a conversation (mải mê trò chuyện).

exercises.instruction: Hành trình đi làm.

options.text: The passengers are navigating their daily commute.
They are hiking up a mountain.
They are lost in the woods.
They are camping in a tent.

exercises.explanation: Navigating their daily commute (Đang thực hiện chuyến đi lại hàng ngày).

exercises.instruction: Hành động vươn cánh tay.

options.text: An arm is extending towards an item.
An arm is being pulled back.
He is folding his arms together.
He is wearing a long-sleeved shirt.

exercises.explanation: Extending towards an item (đang vươn về phía một món đồ).

exercises.instruction: Điền động từ chỉ sự trang bị đầy đủ.
exercises.content: Safety equipment is fully ________ on the worker.
exercises.explanation: Fully equipped (được trang bị đầy đủ).

exercises.instruction: Khán giả tán thưởng.

options.text: The audience is clapping enthusiastically.
The audience is booing the performer.
The audience has left the theater.
The audience is sitting in silence.

exercises.explanation: Clapping enthusiastically (Vỗ tay một cách nhiệt liệt).

exercises.instruction: Đám đông tập trung.

options.text: A multitude has congregated around the display.
The area is evacuated completely.
People are avoiding the center of the room.
A few individuals are sleeping.

exercises.explanation: A multitude has congregated (Một đám đông đã tụ tập).

exercises.instruction: Chuyên gia y tế/nghiên cứu.

options.text: The professional is donning a clinical white coat.
The professional is painting a wall white.
The professional is cooking a meal in an apron.
The professional is delivering mail.

exercises.explanation: Donning a clinical white coat (Đang khoác một chiếc áo blouse trắng).

exercises.instruction: Cuộc đối thoại chuyên nghiệp.

options.text: The men are deep in a business dialogue.
They are playing a board game.
They are ignoring each other at the meeting.
They are eating lunch silently.

exercises.explanation: Deep in a business dialogue (Đắm chìm trong một cuộc hội thoại công việc).

exercises.instruction: Điền động từ chỉ việc đọc qua/xem xét.
exercises.content: The patrons are ________ the shop's offerings.
exercises.explanation: Perusing (xem xét cẩn thận) thường được dùng cho việc xem hàng/đọc sách.

exercises.instruction: Mô tả ngôn ngữ cơ thể.

options.text: He is keeping his hands in his pockets.
He is utilizing hand gestures to communicate.
He is tying his shoes.
He is clapping his hands slowly.

exercises.explanation: Utilizing hand gestures (Sử dụng cử chỉ tay).
